title: Reports of USOM Provincial Representatives (Region III) for the Month Ending 30 September 1965
citation: Reports of USOM Provincial Representatives (Region III) for the Month Ending 30 September 1965, unclassified, Reports Officer, MRCC (Provincial Operations), USOM, Saigon. Wesley R. Fishel Papers, Michigan State University Archives and Historical Collections; digitized in the Virtual Vietnam Archive, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 6-20-19B9-116-UA17-95_001494.
notes: Twenty-two pages of one- and two-page province summaries for III Corps, written by the resident American civilian representative in each province and distributed to the Ambassador's office. Contains the Tay Ninh (24) report for September 1965 - the nearest contemporary civil account of the province, and of Nui Ba Den, found so far for the months of Larry's tour. Its content is discussed in research/records-request/vnca/usom-provincial-reports-1965.md.
